title: benchmark run document
description: The shape of artifacts/bench/latest.json and of every committed baseline under benchmarks/baselines/ (DesignDoc.md S10.3, S10.4, S10.5). Additional keys are permitted so a later measurement can be added without invalidating committed baselines; the `required` sets below are the contract, and every one of them is something a downstream consumer would otherwise KeyError on.

scale.description: The S10.2 scale this run measured. A run is compared against its own scale's row and no other.

verdict.description: S10.3's verdict, written into the run JSON and printed as the last line of stdout.

repeat.description: Number of measured passes the medians and CVs below were computed over (--repeat, default 3).

incremental_ratio.description: S10.3's headline G3 number: phase 6 wall time divided by the summed wall time of phases 1+2+4+5.

blocking_recall.description: S8.5 pins this as a required key of artifacts/bench/latest.json, so it is hoisted to the top level rather than left inside `quality`: it is the only quality number that can fall when a blocking rule stops emitting a key, and edge-level recall hides that failure entirely.

fingerprint.description: S10.4's environment fingerprint. Every field is either an input to the NON-COMPARABLE rule or the diagnostic that identifies the host class.

cgroup_cpu_max.description: /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max as read, e.g. "600000 100000". Stored verbatim because S10.4 derives the quota as quota/period and a pre-divided number loses the period the division used.

nproc.description: In-container nproc. A DIAGNOSTIC with no gate authority: `cpus` is a quota and not a cpuset, so this reports the host core count regardless of the limit (S10.4).

phases.description: The S10.3 measured phases in execution order, each carrying the six per-phase metrics plus the coefficient of variation of wall_ms across the --repeat passes.

wall_ms.description: Median across passes of the monotonic clock around the stage.

wall_ms_cv.description: stdev/mean of wall_ms across passes. Above 0.15 the run is NON_COMPARABLE (S10.4).

records_per_sec.description: rows_out / (wall_ms / 1000) -- per second, not per millisecond.

memory.description: The peak of each of S10.3's three sampled series, reported separately. The cgroup peak is the number S10.4 feeds to k8s sizing; it is the only one that includes DuckDB's out-of-buffer allocations, the Python heap and the dbt subprocess.

quality.description: S10.5's reported-never-gated block, computed by er.eval.pairwise_metrics -- the same implementation the tests call (S8.5). Blocking recall lives at the top level; the edge- and cluster-level triples live here.
